  If arg2's '_courtshipDanceCount' is at most 0, then part uses the move labelled "courtship_dance".
  Otherwise
    Let list3 be [].
    Let v be every x in list2 where part x of arg1 is dead.
    If not v, then append (the id of the move labelled "courtship_dance" on part) to list3.
    Part → lot-and-register-ability-without with (list3).
